fullText.simplified:
第一章、石猴出生

    很久很久以前，海外有座名山，名字叫花果山。花果山漂亮极了，像画一样。那里四季如春，山上桃树常年结果，是个比神仙们住的仙山还要好看的地方。花果山山上的中间有块石头，不知在那儿几万年了，太阳月亮照着它，慢慢地，它变得不一样了。
    这一天，石头轻轻动了一下，接着发出奇怪的声响。石头突然自己开了，一只猴子从石头里跳了出来。这只刚出生的小猴子跪在地上，先向太阳拜了三拜，又向东西南北四个方向拜了拜。接着小猴子的眼睛放出金光，那两道金光直直地照到天上，照进云里。这让住在天上的神仙们非常吃惊，其中两个神仙准备下来看看是怎么回事。结果，他们发现是一只小小的石猴，就没把他放在眼里。
    石猴学东西特别快。出生第一天就学会了爬树，第二天就能下河游泳。没过多久，他就和山里的猴子们成了好朋友。白天他们在树林间玩乐，晚上在大石头下休息，渴了喝山泉水，饿了吃果子，每天都过得非常高兴。
    那是一个很热的下午，天上的太阳像火球一样。猴子们热得大叫，石猴提出去河里玩水，猴子们马上兴奋地跑向小河。大家一个接一个跳进清凉的河水里，有的在洗澡，有的在游泳，玩得开心极了。
    突然，有一只年长的猴子看着河水，提出了一个有趣的问题：“你们说，这水是从哪里来的呢？”
    猴子们低头看向河水。水流得很快，在阳光下，河水发出银色的光，亮亮的。是啊，水是从哪儿来的呢？
fullText.traditional:
第一章、石猴出生

    很久很久以前，海外有座名山，名字叫花果山。花果山漂亮極了，像畫一樣。那裡四季如春，山上桃樹常年結果，是個比神仙們住的仙山還要好看的地方。花果山山上的中間有塊石頭，不知在那兒幾萬年了，太陽月亮照著它，慢慢地，它變得不一樣了。
    這一天，石頭輕輕動了一下，接著發出奇怪的聲響。石頭突然自己開了，一隻猴子從石頭裡跳了出來。這隻剛出生的小猴子跪在地上，先向太陽拜了三拜，又向東西南北四個方向拜了拜。接著小猴子的眼睛放出金光，那兩道金光直直地照到天上，照進雲裡。這讓住在天上的神仙們非常吃驚，其中兩個神仙準備下來看看是怎麼回事。結果，他們發現是一隻小小的石猴，就沒把他放在眼裡。
    石猴學東西特別快。出生第一天就學會了爬樹，第二天就能下河游泳。沒過多久，他就和山裡的猴子們成了好朋友。白天他們在樹林間玩樂，晚上在大石頭下休息，渴了喝山泉水，餓了吃果子，每天都過得非常高興。
    那是一個很熱的下午，天上的太陽像火球一樣。猴子們熱得大叫，石猴提出去河裡玩水，猴子們馬上興奮地跑向小河。大家一個接一個跳進清涼的河水裡，有的在洗澡，有的在游泳，玩得開心極了。
    突然，有一隻年長的猴子看著河水，提出了一個有趣的問題：“你們說，這水是從哪裡來的呢？”
    猴子們低頭看向河水。水流得很快，在陽光下，河水發出銀色的光，亮亮的。是啊，水是從哪兒來的呢？

sentences.simplified: 很久很久以前，海外有座名山，名字叫花果山。
sentences.traditional: 很久很久以前，海外有座名山，名字叫花果山。
sentences.pinyin: hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐ qián hǎi wài yǒu zuò míng shān míng zi jiào huā guǒ shān
sentences.english: A long, long time ago, there was a famous mountain overseas called Mount Huaguo.

sentences.simplified: 花果山漂亮极了，像画一样。
sentences.traditional: 花果山漂亮極了，像畫一樣。
sentences.pinyin: huā guǒ shān piào liang jí le xiàng huà yí yàng
sentences.english: Mount Huaguo was extremely beautiful, like a painting.

sentences.simplified: 那里四季如春，山上桃树常年结果，
sentences.traditional: 那裡四季如春，山上桃樹常年結果，
sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ sì jì rú chūn shān shang táo shù cháng nián jiē guǒ
sentences.english: There, it was like spring all year round, and the peach trees on the mountain bore fruit throughout the year.

sentences.simplified: 是个比神仙们住的仙山还要好看的地方。
sentences.traditional: 是個比神仙們住的仙山還要好看的地方。
sentences.pinyin: shì ge bǐ shén xiān men zhù de xiān shān hái yào hǎo kàn de dì fang
sentences.english: It was a place even more beautiful than the immortal mountains where the immortals lived.

sentences.simplified: 花果山山上的中间有块石头，不知在那儿几万年了，
sentences.traditional: 花果山山上的中間有塊石頭，不知在那兒幾萬年了，
sentences.pinyin: huā guǒ shān shān shang de zhōng jiān yǒu kuài shí tou bù zhī zài nà'r jǐ wàn nián le
sentences.english: In the middle of Mount Huaguo, there was a stone, which had stood there for many tens of thousands of years.

sentences.simplified: 太阳月亮照着它，慢慢地，它变得不一样了。
sentences.traditional: 太陽月亮照著它，慢慢地，它變得不一樣了。
sentences.pinyin: tài yáng yuè liang zhào zhe tā màn man de tā biàn de bù yí yàng le
sentences.english: The sun and the moon shone upon it, and little by little, it began to change.

sentences.simplified: 这一天，石头轻轻动了一下，接着发出奇怪的声响。
sentences.traditional: 這一天，石頭輕輕動了一下，接著發出奇怪的聲響。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì tiān shí tou qīng qīng dòng le yí xià jiē zhe fā chū qí guài de shēng xiǎng
sentences.english: On this day, the stone moved slightly, and then it let out a strange sound.

sentences.simplified: 石头突然自己开了，一只猴子从石头里跳了出来。
sentences.traditional: 石頭突然自己開了，一隻猴子從石頭裡跳了出來。
sentences.pinyin: shí tou tū rán zì jǐ kāi le yì zhī hóu zi cóng shí tou lǐ tiào le chu lai
sentences.english: The stone suddenly opened by itself, and a monkey jumped out from the stone.

sentences.simplified: 这只刚出生的小猴子跪在地上，
sentences.traditional: 這隻剛出生的小猴子跪在地上，
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhī gāng chū shēng de xiǎo hóu zi guì zài dì shang
sentences.english: The newborn little monkey knelt on the ground, ..

sentences.simplified: 先向太阳拜了三拜，又向东西南北四个方向拜了拜。
sentences.traditional: 先向太陽拜了三拜，又向東西南北四個方向拜了拜。
sentences.pinyin: xiān xiàng tài yáng bài le sān bài yòu xiàng dōng xī nán běi sì ge fāng xiàng bài le bài
sentences.english: .. first bowing three times to the sun, then bowing in turn to the four directions: east, west, south, and north.

sentences.simplified: 接着小猴子的眼睛放出金光，那两道金光直直地照到天上，照进云里。
sentences.traditional: 接著小猴子的眼睛放出金光，那兩道金光直直地照到天上，照進雲裡。
sentences.pinyin: jiē zhe xiǎo hóu zi de yǎn jing fàng chū jīn guāng nà liǎng dào jīn guāng zhí zhí de zhào dào tiān shàng zhào jìn yún lǐ
sentences.english: Then, the little monkey’s eyes emitted golden light. The two beams of golden light shone straight into the sky, penetrating the clouds.

sentences.simplified: 这让住在天上的神仙们非常吃惊，其中两个神仙准备下来看看是怎么回事。
sentences.traditional: 這讓住在天上的神仙們非常吃驚，其中兩個神仙準備下來看看是怎麼回事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ràng zhù zài tiān shàng de shén xiān men fēi cháng chī jīng qí zhōng liǎng ge shén xiān zhǔn bèi xià lai kàn kan shì zěn me huí shì
sentences.english: This greatly surprised the immortals living in the heavens, so two immortals prepared to come down to see what was happening.

sentences.simplified: 结果，他们发现是一只小小的石猴，就没把他放在眼里。
sentences.traditional: 結果，他們發現是一隻小小的石猴，就沒把他放在眼裡。
sentences.pinyin: jié guǒ tā men fā xiàn shì yì zhī xiǎo xiǎo de shí hóu jiù méi bǎ tā fàng zài yǎn lǐ
sentences.english: In the end, they discovered it was just a little stone monkey, so they didn’t pay much attention to him.

sentences.simplified: 石猴学东西特别快。
sentences.traditional: 石猴學東西特別快。
sentences.pinyin: shí hóu xué dōng xi tè bié kuài
sentences.english: The stone monkey learned things especially quickly.

sentences.simplified: 出生第一天就学会了爬树，第二天就能下河游泳。
sentences.traditional: 出生第一天就學會了爬樹，第二天就能下河游泳。
sentences.pinyin: chū shēng dì yī tiān jiù xué huì le pá shù dì èr tiān jiù néng xià hé yóu yǒng
sentences.english: On the day of his birth, he learned to climb trees, and by the second day, he could swim in the river.

sentences.simplified: 没过多久，他就和山里的猴子们成了好朋友。
sentences.traditional: 沒過多久，他就和山裡的猴子們成了好朋友。
sentences.pinyin: méi guò duō jiǔ tā jiù hé shān lǐ de hóu zi men chéng le hǎo péng you
sentences.english: Before long, he became good friends with the monkeys on the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 白天他们在树林间玩乐，晚上在大石头下休息，
sentences.traditional: 白天他們在樹林間玩樂，晚上在大石頭下休息，
sentences.pinyin: bái tiān tā men zài shù lín jiān wán lè wǎn shang zài dà shí tou xià xiū xi
sentences.english: During the day, they played in the forest, and at night, they rested beneath the big stone.

sentences.simplified: 渴了喝山泉水，饿了吃果子，每天都过得非常高兴。
sentences.traditional: 渴了喝山泉水，餓了吃果子，每天都過得非常高興。
sentences.pinyin: kě le hē shān quán shuǐ è le chī guǒ zi měi tiān dōu guò de fēi cháng gāo xìng
sentences.english: When they were thirsty, they drank from the mountain spring; when they were hungry, they ate fruit. Each day was filled with joy.

sentences.simplified: 那是一个很热的下午，天上的太阳像火球一样。
sentences.traditional: 那是一個很熱的下午，天上的太陽像火球一樣。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì yí ge hěn rè de xià wǔ tiān shàng de tài yáng xiàng huǒ qiú yí yàng
sentences.english: It was a very hot afternoon, and the sun in the sky was like a fireball.

sentences.simplified: 猴子们热得大叫，石猴提出去河里玩水，
sentences.traditional: 猴子們熱得大叫，石猴提出去河裡玩水，
sentences.pinyin: hóu zi men rè de dà jiào shí hóu tí chū qù hé lǐ wán shuǐ
sentences.english: The monkeys cried out from the heat, so the stone monkey suggested going to the river to play in the water.

sentences.simplified: 猴子们马上兴奋地跑向小河。
sentences.traditional: 猴子們馬上興奮地跑向小河。
sentences.pinyin: hóu zi men mǎ shàng xīng fèn de pǎo xiàng xiǎo hé
sentences.english: The monkeys immediately ran excitedly towards the small river.

sentences.simplified: 大家一个接一个跳进清凉的河水里，
sentences.traditional: 大家一個接一個跳進清涼的河水裡，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā yí ge jiē yí ge tiào jìn qīng liáng de hé shuǐ lǐ
sentences.english: Everyone jumped into the cool river water one after another.

sentences.simplified: 有的在洗澡，有的在游泳，玩得开心极了。
sentences.traditional: 有的在洗澡，有的在游泳，玩得開心極了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de zài xǐ zǎo yǒu de zài yóu yǒng wán de kāi xīn jí le
sentences.english: Some were bathing, and some were swimming. They were having a great time.

sentences.simplified: 突然，有一只年长的猴子看着河水，提出了一个有趣的问题：
sentences.traditional: 突然，有一隻年長的猴子看著河水，提出了一個有趣的問題：
sentences.pinyin: tū rán yǒu yì zhī nián zhǎng de hóu zi kàn zhe hé shuǐ tí chū le yí ge yǒu qù de wèn tí
sentences.english: Suddenly, an older monkey looked at the river and posed an interesting question:

sentences.simplified: “你们说，这水是从哪里来的呢？”
sentences.traditional: “你們說，這水是從哪裡來的呢？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ men shuō zhè shuǐ shì cóng nǎ lǐ lái de ne
sentences.english: “Everyone, tell me, where do you think this water comes from?”

sentences.simplified: 猴子们低头看向河水。
sentences.traditional: 猴子們低頭看向河水。
sentences.pinyin: hóu zi men dī tóu kàn xiàng hé shuǐ
sentences.english: The monkeys lowered their heads and looked into the river.

sentences.simplified: 水流得很快，在阳光下，河水发出银色的光，亮亮的。
sentences.traditional: 水流得很快，在陽光下，河水發出銀色的光，亮亮的。
sentences.pinyin: shuǐ liú de hěn kuài zài yáng guāng xià hé shuǐ fā chū yín sè de guāng liàng liàng de
sentences.english: The water flowed swiftly, and under the sunlight, it shone with a bright, silvery light.

sentences.simplified: 是啊，水是从哪儿来的呢？
sentences.traditional: 是啊，水是從哪兒來的呢？
sentences.pinyin: shì a shuǐ shì cóng nǎ'r lái de ne
sentences.english: Yes, where did this water come from?

sentence_translations: Chapter 1: Birth of the Stone Monkey
A long, long time ago, there was a famous mountain overseas called Mount Huaguo.
Mount Huaguo was extremely beautiful, like a painting.
There, it was like spring all year round, and the peach trees on the mountain bore fruit throughout the year.
It was a place even more beautiful than the immortal mountains where the immortals lived.
In the middle of Mount Huaguo, there was a stone, which had stood there for many tens of thousands of years.
The sun and the moon shone upon it, and little by little, it began to change.
On this day, the stone moved slightly, and then it let out a strange sound.
The stone suddenly opened by itself, and a monkey jumped out from the stone.
The newborn little monkey knelt on the ground, ..
.. first bowing three times to the sun, then bowing in turn to the four directions: east, west, south, and north.
Then, the little monkey’s eyes emitted golden light. The two beams of golden light shone straight into the sky, penetrating the clouds.
This greatly surprised the immortals living in the heavens, so two immortals prepared to come down to see what was happening.
In the end, they discovered it was just a little stone monkey, so they didn’t pay much attention to him.
The stone monkey learned things especially quickly.
On the day of his birth, he learned to climb trees, and by the second day, he could swim in the river.
Before long, he became good friends with the monkeys on the mountain.
During the day, they played in the forest, and at night, they rested beneath the big stone.
When they were thirsty, they drank from the mountain spring; when they were hungry, they ate fruit. Each day was filled with joy.
It was a very hot afternoon, and the sun in the sky was like a fireball.
The monkeys cried out from the heat, so the stone monkey suggested going to the river to play in the water.
The monkeys immediately ran excitedly towards the small river.
Everyone jumped into the cool river water one after another.
Some were bathing, and some were swimming. They were having a great time.
Suddenly, an older monkey looked at the river and posed an interesting question:
“Everyone, tell me, where do you think this water comes from?”
The monkeys lowered their heads and looked into the river.
The water flowed swiftly, and under the sunlight, it shone with a bright, silvery light.
Yes, where did this water come from?
